text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Anchors aweigh!
Come on, set sail for the treasure!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Aiming for 1st prize!
Here is the special koban coin guaranteed to bring good fortune~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On our way back from an outing with Tap Dance City,
we bumped into Matikane Fukukitaru
and joined a treasure hunt game together.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Let's see, the clue to the treasure is...
'The place of beginnings. The spot I face
gently ripples with countless lights upon the water's surface.'
choice_data_list: The water's surface... maybe a river or a fountain?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Mhfufu~. This is my time to shine!
Hocus pocus, abracadabra~!
Riddle solved in a snap~!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Aha! I see it!
It's water, alright, but a whole, whole lot of water!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Then it's gotta be the ocean!
'Cause it's the biggest thing on Earth!!
choice_data_list: Since it's an interactive town game, maybe the pond?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
No way, the scale of the game doesn't matter!
All that matters is steering towards romance!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
The needle of my heart's compass is pointing to the sea!
Not wavering a single millimeter! Let's go!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Arriving at the wharf closest to town,
I found a hint for the next destination.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"Woo-hoo!
Looks like my compass was right after all!"

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Now then, what's next...?
"A place where birds rest their great wings.
Looking at them, I thought of the journey ahead."
choice_data_list: If it's birds, maybe an amusement park or a pet shop?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"...Ha! How should I put it, it felt kinda heavy...
I didn't see any normal-looking bird at all!?"

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Heavy, big wings... that's gotta be an airplane!
How about the airport? Sounds like a real trip, right?!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Well now, finally the last hint...
'My treasure, more precious than all things,
sleeps in the land worthy of it'... huh.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Gyall! It only mentions treasure!
How am I even supposed to divine this~~?!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"...Maybe the treasure itself is the hint.
Hey, Trainer. How would you solve it?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
More precious than anything...?
Then perhaps it's a play on words between
its high value and a high location...

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Oh, looks like you got an idea.
Let's go check it out!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I came here thinking it would be a high vantage point
overlooking the town, but...
choice_data_list: Sorry, looks like I made a mistake...

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
It's no big deal!
It's the final problem. Of course it's gonna be hard!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
“Still, I reckon you're right about it bein' somewhere high up.
After all, you're the one who thought of it!”

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"So, let's head to the highest spot in town!
To chase after one last grand romance!!"

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Allllright! Goal!!
Hand over the treasure, will ya?!

text_block_list.name: Game Staff
text_block_list.text:
Unfortunately, you were just shy of first place...
You took just a little too long.
And so, here is your second-place medal!
choice_data_list: It's all because I messed up once...

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Come on... Look up. And puff out your chest.
Whose fault is it that we reached the finish line?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: It was you!!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
We made it to the goal
because you found the clue!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"So, no one is blaming you.
Right?"

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Yes! Having fun playing with everyone makes me ultra happy~!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"You see?
That's why it's a huge success! That was a great adventure!"
choice_data_list: I want to have a rematch!
The final question was really tough.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"Haha! Looks like you were really frustrated!
I don't mind that stubbornness of yours one bit!"

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: "As long as your spirit doesn't break, you can go on an adventure anytime, as many times as you want!"

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Weigh anchor, hoist the sails! Let's board the same ship once again and part the seas!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
So don't look so down.
Hardships are just part of the adventure, after all.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"Treasure that's easy to get
isn't really worth appreciating, right?"

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"If you're still not feeling up to it, then let's throw an after-party! A banquet!!
Raising a ruckus will surely clear your head!"
